messages:
emily (docs): Quick sync: we need to coordinate the v1 -> v2 ramp for the public API. Proposal: 14d deprecation banner with warnings, then a 7d enforcement window. Primary concerns: example snippets, redirect mapping, and an explicit 'what-to-fix' checklist. I'll draft the migration quickstart.

raj (sdk): Acknowledged. SDK surface change is the 'model' -> 'model_id' rename and a few embedding dim changes. We'll deploy a short-lived compat shim that accepts both keys for 2 weeks. I'll open an SDK PR with unit tests and an example showing aliasing.

mica (devex): Owners: @raj (sdk), @emily (docs), @noah (oncall). I'll prepare a troubleshooting section listing common 422/400 cases and a one-line smoke curl to add to CI. Can someone run a repo-wide search for "/v1/invoke" and old snippets?

raj (sdk): Quick grep suggestion: `rg "\/v1\/invoke|\bmodel\s*:\s*\"" -n docs/ examples/`. Example alias snippet I'll add to SDK README:
```js
// temporary alias shim
client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-redwood') })
```

noah (eng-oncall): I'll ready a canary and rollback playbook. Rollback command for ops notes: `./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback:migration"`. Canary threshold: if error rate delta >0.5% we initiate rollback. I'll post metrics to #release-war-room.

emily (docs): Docs checklist: 1) add banner with dates; 2) migration quickstart with concrete fixes; 3) update js/py/curl snippets; 4) update redirect map; 5) link smoke test script. I'll take 1 & 2 and will include a 'what breaks' bullet list.

mica (devex): Smoke curl to use in CI:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}'
```
Expect 200 and token_count. I'll add this to /scripts/smoke/migrate_check.sh.

ci-bot: Reminder: docs PRs must pass link-checker and code-block-lint. Broken links will fail CI.

raj (sdk): I'll include a note in the SDK changelog and put the ops rollback one-liner in ops/NOTES. Will also add a small test that both 'model' and 'model_id' are accepted by the shim.

emily (docs): Action items recap: raj -> SDK PR + compat tests + ops note; mica -> smoke script + troubleshooting bullets; noah -> rollback playbook & canary; emily -> migration quickstart + banner. Target: soft deprecation announcement tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
